verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair question for an accounting system, but the evidence never shows Books exporting its ledger, journal entries or reports in open formats such as CSV. The QuickBooks, NetSuite and Xero syncs describe banking data flowing into other ledgers, and Books is explicitly built to replace those tools rather than sync with them. The full accounting API is only promised for the future, so there is no documented way to take all your Books data and leave.
